1.summary:
## Summary

Matching a selector that uses the descendant combinator (`a b`) takes time that grows polynomially with how deeply the document is nested, and each extra descendant combinator in the selector raises the degree by one. 1.summary:
### Impact

An unauthenticated caller able to reach the query endpoint could exhaust database and server resources with ordinary, inexpensive requests.

The keyword-search arm read the entire corpus on every request and rebuilt an in-memory BM25 index from it, so the cost of serving a query scaled with the size of the source table rather than with the size of the result set.
